verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's IAM docs say it controls who can do what on which resource, which covers resource-level scoping. They also describe IAM as managing fine-grained permissions, so least privilege is expressible at its core. The pack does not evidence IAM conditions or documented policy evaluation, two explicit parts of the story. Missing for 10: IAM Conditions / conditional policies, documented policy evaluation logic (inheritance, deny/allow precedence), independent or hands-on corroboration.
